reuse.why: Extends the existing isOffDay and recurConfigToExdates in shared/schedules.ts, so every weekend-rule caller picks it up without new call-site code.

duplication.why: The meaning of an MM-DD entry is encoded twice in different shapes: a day.slice(5) set lookup in isOffDay and a regex-plus-year-expansion in recurConfigToExdates, with no shared holiday-entry parser.

placement.why: Both edits sit in the shared schedule module that owns holiday handling.

scope.why: Limited to the two holiday functions, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The exdate expansion relies on an arbitrary hard-coded window (ten years back, fifty ahead) tied to the current clock, and the two encodings of the entry format can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Changes are inside the existing holiday helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts: MM-DD recognition as holidays.has(day.slice(5)) in isOffDay vs /^\d{2}-\d{2}$/ parsing in recurConfigToExdates.
